QuestInfo.name: To the Sealed Garden
QuestInfo.0: You'll find #m920030001# in #m200000000#... You wonder if it's related to the Seal Stone. You bet #b#p2032001##k in #b#m200050000##k can explain a thing or two.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p2032001#, #m920030001# is where the #bSeal Stone is hidden#k. The only way to enter #m920030001# is through a stem of the Nependeath which connects #m200060001# to #m920030001#. An intruder has actually grown the #o9300347# for this specific purpose. #p2032001# is desperately asking you to prevent the intruders from entering...
QuestInfo.2: You found Dargoth in the #m920030001# and defeated them, but ended up losing the Seal Stone to Hiver, another member of the Black Wings. Could this get any worse?

0.0: Honestly, I don't know much about #m920030001# either. All I know is that under the order of the Empress, the #bgarden with the hidden Seal Stone#k is off limits to anyone trying to enter the premises. It's that sacred.
0.1: There's only one way to get to #m920030001#. There's a #bflower pot at the center of#k #m200060001#, and you must make the Nependeath inside the pot grow so it'll connect to #m920030001#. Then you climb up the branches all the way to #m920030001#.
0.2: Which means... The reason the #o9300347# was found in #m200060001# is because #rsomeone is trying to enter #m920030001##k. Although the intruder failed because their approach was incorrect, they will be back, and they will succeed. We'll need to prevent them from doing that, and... it'll be up to you to stop them.
0.3: I don't know what the Seal Stone does. I'd imagine that very few people in #m200000000# are even aware of its existence. I wonder what role it plays in your destiny...
0.4: Your destiny reaches beyond my sight, to heights I can barely comprehend. That...sure is something. I can say with some certainly that you will #bsave the world#k, though.
0.5: Go back to #b#m920030000##k. If you see a #bpath#kmade of Nependeath vines, that means #bsomebody has been tresspassing#k! Deal with them if you can catch them.\r\n\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move immediately to #m920030000#.)

no.0: You can't escape your destiny. This is your calling.
